summary: Resolved F02 All Saints for Sunday 1 November 2026 against the 1962 facsimile (pp. 702-703, nos. 3974-3983), the Calendarium, RG/RGMR and five hashed dated witnesses. Recorded a 14-element inventory: the feast's propers plus the required privileged commemoration of the Twenty-third Sunday in the Collect, Secret and Postcommunion. The Preface is recorded as disputed (Trinity n. 1082 or common n. 1086) for research to settle, and the lawful Latin and English routes and remaining verification are planned. Also created the main.tex owner scaffold.
